checks.extrapolation: Per-run cost is dominated by the row-count-dependent probe fits, not by the option count. Anchor: dmcc's two full-size runs on the same 12,067 rows took 16.7 and 16.8 min launch to finish (run records dmcc-pointer-popqa / dmcc-letter-logits-popqa). The IDK option adds one short line (prompt 76-124 tokens), at most about 5% of capture (about 151 s at 12.6 ms/row), i.e. under 10 s per run. Estimate about 17 min per engine run, 12 runs about 3.4 h; plus recognition about 0.85 h; total about 4.3 h of GPU in separate stages (AMENDMENT estimate 4-4.5 h). Every engine run stays far below the 2 h tool limit.
